blocks.text: Together We Can takes a unique approach to addiction treatment by using evidence-based therapies and a community-based approach. Their aim is to help individuals struggling with addiction find lasting recovery by creating an environment that fosters connection and support. This approach has been successful in helping many individuals conquer their addiction and live fulfilling, sober lives.
blocks.html: Together We Can takes a unique approach to addiction treatment by using evidence-based therapies and a community-based approach. Their aim is to help individuals struggling with addiction find lasting recovery by creating an environment that fosters connection and support. This approach has been successful in helping many individuals conquer their addiction and live fulfilling, sober lives.

blocks.text: The Main Centre is the flagship program offered by Together We Can. Consisting of 5 residential homes, it provides clients with access to counseling and group spaces, as well as a fitness center. This program is grounded in the 12-Step approach, which has been shown to be effective in treating addiction. Other programs offered by Together We Can include Elevate, Solid Ground, Alliance, and All My Relations. Each of these programs has been designed with a specific goal in mind and uses different therapeutic approaches to help individuals in their recovery journey.

blocks.text: Health and wellness play a critical role in addiction recovery. Exercise has been shown to help reduce stress, increase dopamine levels, and promote overall well-being. To help clients achieve optimal wellness, Together We Can offers a fully equipped, state-of-the-art fitness center staffed with 2 personal trainers. Clients work closely with these fitness experts as well as dietitians to develop individualized plans that meet their specific needs.

children.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Together We Can

blocks.text: Who is Together We Can - Addiction Recovery & Education Society?
Established in Vancouver, Canada in 2012, Together We Can is a non-profit organization that offers addiction treatment services and programs for those seeking recovery from substance use disorders.
blocks.html: Established in Vancouver, Canada in 2012, Together We Can is a non-profit organization that offers addiction treatment services and programs for those seeking recovery from substance use disorders.

blocks.text: What addiction treatment services does Together We Can provide?

Together We Can provides a variety of addiction treatment solutions, such as residential treatment programs, outpatient programs and aftercare support systems. Their residential facilities include The Main Centre, Elevate, Solid Ground, The Alliance and All My Relations – each offering different treatment modalities and systems.
blocks.html: Together We Can provides a variety of addiction treatment solutions, such as residential treatment programs, outpatient programs and aftercare support systems. Their residential facilities include The Main Centre, Elevate, Solid Ground, The Alliance and All My Relations – each offering different treatment modalities and systems.

blocks.text: How much does addiction treatment at Together We Can cost?

The cost of addiction treatment at Together We Can is determined by the program and individual needs. The organization works closely with clients to guarantee they receive the necessary assistance no matter their financial situation.
blocks.html: The cost of addiction treatment at Together We Can is determined by the program and individual needs. The organization works closely with clients to guarantee they receive the necessary assistance no matter their financial situation.

blocks.text: Do I Need a Referral From a Healthcare Provider to Access Addiction Treatment at Together We Can?

No, you do not require a referral from your healthcare provider in order to access addiction treatment at Together We Can. The organization accepts self-referrals and welcomes anyone seeking help for addiction.
blocks.html: No, you do not require a referral from your healthcare provider in order to access addiction treatment at Together We Can. The organization accepts self-referrals and welcomes anyone seeking help for addiction.

blocks.text: Are the addiction treatment programs offered at Together We Can evidence-based?
Yes, our addiction treatment programs are evidence-based and designed to give clients the best chance for successful recovery.
blocks.html: Yes, our addiction treatment programs are evidence-based and designed to give clients the best chance for successful recovery.

blocks.text: Does Together We Can offer aftercare support services?

Absolutely, Together We Can provides aftercare support services for clients who have completed their addiction treatment programs. These include ongoing counseling, peer support groups and relapse prevention strategies.
blocks.html: Absolutely, Together We Can provides aftercare support services for clients who have completed their addiction treatment programs. These include ongoing counseling, peer support groups and relapse prevention strategies.

blocks.text: How long does addiction treatment at Together We Can last?

The duration of addiction treatment at Together We Can is tailored to each individual’s needs and the program they enroll in. Residential programs usually last 30-90 days, while outpatient ones may extend for several months or more.

blocks.text: Is addiction treatment at Together We Can confidential?
Absolutely. The organization takes great care to maintain client privacy and confidentiality, keeping all personal information strictly private in accordance with privacy laws and regulations.

Together We Can: A Community-Based Approach to Addiction Treatment

Together We Can is a specialist in addiction treatment using evidence-based therapies and a community-based approach. The organization operates five residential programs to meet different needs; The Main Centre is its largest location, consisting of five homes, counseling and group spaces as well as an exercise facility – all following a 12-step recovery model.

Elevate is a private residential treatment home that offers care and therapy to individuals suffering from substance abuse issues, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), or trauma. The program utilizes cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical-behavioral therapy (DBT), as well as 12-step facilitation.

Solid Ground is a non-12-step recovery program that utilizes narrative therapy, motivational interviewing (MI), and group activities. With its low staff-to-client ratio, the program emphasizes building relationships and trust – essential ingredients for long-lasting change.

The Alliance program offers an inclusive, safe, and supportive atmosphere for clients to work through trauma and rebuild their life. It promotes an accepting atmosphere without judgment or condemnation.

Finally, the All My Relations program utilizes indigenous cultural traditions and ceremonies to address substance use disorder among indigenous men.

Residential homes are situated away from the main campus to give clients a sense of independence and real-world living while still being conveniently close. Frequently Asked Questions About Together We Can

Who is Together We Can - Addiction Recovery & Education Society?

Established in Vancouver, Canada in 2012, Together We Can is a non-profit organization that offers addiction treatment services and programs for those seeking recovery from substance use disorders.

What addiction treatment services does Together We Can provide?

Together We Can provides a variety of addiction treatment solutions, such as residential treatment programs, outpatient programs and aftercare support systems. Their residential facilities include The Main Centre, Elevate, Solid Ground, The Alliance and All My Relations – each offering different treatment modalities and systems.

How much does addiction treatment at Together We Can cost?

The cost of addiction treatment at Together We Can is determined by the program and individual needs. The organization works closely with clients to guarantee they receive the necessary assistance no matter their financial situation.

Do I Need a Referral From a Healthcare Provider to Access Addiction Treatment at Together We Can?

No, you do not require a referral from your healthcare provider in order to access addiction treatment at Together We Can. The organization accepts self-referrals and welcomes anyone seeking help for addiction.

Are the addiction treatment programs offered at Together We Can evidence-based?

Yes, our addiction treatment programs are evidence-based and designed to give clients the best chance for successful recovery.

Does Together We Can offer aftercare support services?

Absolutely, Together We Can provides aftercare support services for clients who have completed their addiction treatment programs. These include ongoing counseling, peer support groups and relapse prevention strategies.

How long does addiction treatment at Together We Can last?

The duration of addiction treatment at Together We Can is tailored to each individual’s needs and the program they enroll in. Residential programs usually last 30-90 days, while outpatient ones may extend for several months or more.

Is addiction treatment at Together We Can confidential?

Absolutely. The organization takes great care to maintain client privacy and confidentiality, keeping all personal information strictly private in accordance with privacy laws and regulations.

Together We Can is a specialist in addiction treatment using evidence-based therapies and a community-based approach. The organization operates five residential programs to meet different needs; The Main Centre is its largest location, consisting of five homes, counseling and group spaces as well as an exercise facility – all following a 12-step recovery model.

Elevate is a private residential treatment home that offers care and therapy to individuals suffering from substance abuse issues, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), or trauma. The program utilizes cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical-behavioral therapy (DBT), as well as 12-step facilitation.

Solid Ground is a non-12-step recovery program that utilizes narrative therapy, motivational interviewing (MI), and group activities. With its low staff-to-client ratio, the program emphasizes building relationships and trust – essential ingredients for long-lasting change.

The Alliance program offers an inclusive, safe, and supportive atmosphere for clients to work through trauma and rebuild their life. It promotes an accepting atmosphere without judgment or condemnation.

Finally, the All My Relations program utilizes indigenous cultural traditions and ceremonies to address substance use disorder among indigenous men.

Clients work closely with fitness trainers and dietitians to maximize their results during this process.
